data.one_liner: A slider that triggers a callback when slid to 100%.
data.what_it_does: The ConfirmationSlider widget displays a horizontal slider that the user can drag to the end. When the slider reaches 100%, it calls the provided onConfirmation callback.
use_when: Confirming destructive actions like delete or logout
Triggering a one-time action that requires user intent
Replacing a button with a more engaging UI
avoid_when: Complex animations that need custom physics
When you need a fully custom draggable widget with non-linear behavior
When the project requires a permissive license
strengths: Simple API with only one required callback
weaknesses: GPL-3.0 license may restrict commercial use
Limited to a single slider type, no advanced gestures
